programs.source: local function encode64(source) local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/" local output = {} for first = 1, #source, 3 do local remaining = math.min(3, #source - first + 1) local value = 0 for offset = 0, 2 do value = value * 256 + (offset < remaining and source:byte(first + offset) or 0) end for i, divisor in ipairs({262144, 4096, 64, 1}) do local index = (value // divisor) % 64 + 1 output[#output + 1] = i <= remaining + 1 and alphabet:sub(index, index) or "=" return table.concat(output) for _, source in ipairs({"Man", "Hello, World!", "", "bold", "a+b=c?"}) do local encoded = encode64(source) io.write(string.format('"%s" -> "%s"\n', source, encoded))
